title: Source Package Manifest for Capability Studio Gate A1
description: Root-level packageFP and manifestEnvelope separated per Design 00/01. manifestEnvelope contains algorithmVersion, orderedDescriptors, treeRoot — it excludes packageFP. Draft 2020-12.

packageFP.description: Package fingerprint as WireDigest. TypedFP('rg.gatea.package.v1', manifestEnvelope). Per 00 §2.3.

manifestEnvelope.description: Package-level metadata envelope. Does NOT contain packageFP; contains algorithmVersion, orderedDescriptors, treeRoot instead. Per Design 00/01.

orderedDescriptors.description: Sorted list of source unit descriptors (UTF-8 byte order ascending).

treeRoot.description: Merkle tree root as WireDigest. Single leaf: treeRoot = leaf. Multiple leaves: treeRoot = top-level node.

sourceDescriptor.description: Descriptor for a single source unit within the package.

path.description: Relative path to the source unit file (UTF-8 normalized, no leading /).
